service.description: Home's service measures for the user's scope over a period (the last 30 days by default): open, overdue, unassigned, SLA compliance, first response, resolution and CSAT, each with its label, value text (null where not configured), whether it is configured, its denominator and the change against the previous period of the same length; the period and the time they were read; and which of Home's panels the user's role sees (my cases, team queues, returns awaiting approval, approvals waiting). Refuses a user without Customer Service.

parameter.name: measures
parameter.description: Each measure's key, label, icon, configured, valueText, denominatorText and changeText.

parameter.name: panels
parameter.description: myCases, teamQueues, awaitingReturns and approvalsWaiting: whether the user's role sees the panel (design §1).

set.from: ec.l10n.format(periodStart, 'd MMM yyyy') + ' – ' + ec.l10n.format(ec.user.nowTimestamp, 'd MMM yyyy')

[ {key: 'open', label: 'Open', icon: 'sym_o_inbox'}, {key: 'overdue', label: 'Overdue', icon: 'sym_o_schedule'}, {key: 'unassigned', label: 'Unassigned', icon: 'sym_o_person_off'}, {key: 'slaCompliance', label: 'SLA compliance', icon: 'sym_o_verified'}, {key: 'firstResponse', label: 'First response', icon: 'sym_o_reply'}, {key: 'resolution', label: 'Resolution', icon: 'sym_o_task_alt'}, {key: 'csat', label: 'CSAT', icon: 'sym_o_sentiment_satisfied'} ].map((measure) => Object.assign(measure, {configured: false, valueText: null, denominatorText: null, changeText: null}))
